Court Delays Plan to Detonate Toxic Explosives in Iowa
US army postpones plan to detonate bomb-making chemical amid outcry

lines.text: Did the US army stop a big blast?
Yes, they delayed a chemical detonation plan in Iowa.
Why did they delay the plan?
People worried a toxic cloud with lead particles would form.
Lead particles? That sounds very dangerous!
Residents and state officials spoke out against the risk.
What happens next with the chemical stash?
We must watch what the army decides to do.
